name: Tarchia
isnote: Arbour concluded that Minotaurasaurus is a junior synonym of Tarchia (cited revision of Tarchia), while the revision of Minotaurasaurus treats it as distinct; both entries are kept until reviewed.
sum: Tarchia is a large ankylosaurid from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia, based on a skull from the Barun Goyot Formation.
holotype: ZPal MgD-I/111, a skull found in 1970 — Barun Goyot Formation, Nemegt Basin, near Khulsan, Mongolia.
material: Further species include T. tumanovae (MPC-D 100/1353, a partial skeleton with skull).
biology: Known from skulls and some postcrania; no behavioural data in the sources used.
author: Maryanska 1977
